charter.d: Celestial, ASUKA, ZM aur TOMAN ek alliance hain. Alliance ke kisi bhi member par hamla, sab par hamla.
Alliance ke andar jhagda ho to leaders baat karke suljhate hain. Koi apni marzi se war shuru nahi karta.
Alliance gangs ke naam, tag aur leaders ki public mein izzat karo.

ranks.d: Gang ka chehra. Final decisions, wars aur alliance meetings.
Leader ke saath chalte hain, roster aur events sambhalte hain.

celestial.d: Gang ke andar ya bahar kisi ko gaali ya insult nahi.
7 din se zyada bina batae gayab raho to rank ghat sakta hai.
Server par gang tag lagake hi khelo.
Gang ki planning aur chats bahar share nahi hoti.
Disagree ho to DM mein baat karo, public mein nahi.

asuka.d: War mein orders leader ke through hi aate hain.
Bina permission kisi gang se panga nahi.

zm.d: War mein dum dikhao, par apne logon ki izzat karo.
Individual stats se pehle team ki jeet.

toman.d: Toman ka naam izzat se liya jata hai. Kisi kamzor par haath nahi.
Dost ke liye khada rehna, chahe kuch bhi ho.
Meeting aur war time par samay se aao.
